{{also|fôlder}}
==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
From {{af|en|fold|-er|id2=agent noun}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈfoʊldɚ/|a=GenAm}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈfəʊldə/|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-folder.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|əʊldə(ɹ)|s=2}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}
[[File:38254-new folder-3.svg|thumbnail|A typical icon of a folder (2)]]

# An [[organizer]] that [[paper]]s are kept in, usually with an [[index]] tab, to be stored as a single unit in a [[filing cabinet]].
#: {{ux|en|I keep all my schoolwork in a yellow '''folder'''.}}
# {{lb|en|computing}} A [[virtual]] container in a [[computer]]'s [[file system]], in which [[file]]s and other folders may be [[store]]d. The files and [[subfolder]]s in a folder are usually [[related]].
#: {{syn|en|directory}}
#: {{ux|en|My essays are in the '''folder''' named "Schoolwork".}}
# A machine or person that [[fold]]s things.
# {{senseid|en|Q115929617}} A [[folding knife]], typically a folding [[pocketknife]].
#* {{quote-book|en|date=2010-08-20|author=Joe Kertzman|title=Knives 2011: The World's Greatest Knife Book|publisher=F+W Media, Inc.|isbn=9781440216282
|text=A funny name for a knife, the Needs Work '''folder''' is purpose-built as a working '''folder''', and includes a straight, plain-edge, modified-wharncliffe blade, and a comfortable, ergonomic handle.}}
